title: The World of the future
creator_credit: Hobel-Leiterman Productions, Philip S. Hobel, Douglas Leiterman and Peter Thurling
brief_description: Looks at the changing lifestyles and subcultures of the future, the changing environment and the effect on people, their values and their ability to cope. Includes footage from George Lucas’ first science fiction feature “THX-1138”.
